نتسايف (form VI)
# نَتَسَايَفُ (natasāyafu) /na.ta.saː.ja.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَسَايَفَ (tasāyafa)
# نَتَسَايَفَ (natasāyafa) /na.ta.saː.ja.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَسَايَفَ (tasāyafa)
# نَتَسَايَفْ (natasāyaf) /na.ta.saː.jaf/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَسَايَفَ (tasāyafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
